Hi Alex — Laura from Billing here. Thanks for the invoice. I reviewed invoice #12431 and the account activity. Summary: the signup promo credit was applied on 2026-11-01 and covered usage through 2026-11-22. After that, normal metered usage continued and resulted in the 2026-11-29 charge. The system applies credits automatically; however credits have a 30-day validity window from issuance in the self-serve flow.

Regarding VAT: because Storix has an EU billing address and we don't currently have a validated EU VAT number on file, VAT was charged at the standard rate for digital services. If you provide a valid EU VAT number or VAT-exemption documentation, we can evaluate a tax adjustment and, where applicable, issue a refund for VAT on the charged amount.

I can do two things immediately once we have the VAT number and the promo code: 1) audit the credit application and confirm whether the code was entered against the same billing account (common mismatch), and 2) process a one-time goodwill credit for the overage if the promo was not applied due to an internal error.

Please reply with the VAT number and the exact promo code. If you prefer, I can set up a 15-minute call to walk through the ledger live.

Thanks,
